problem.name: Elicit
problem.description: AI research assistant that searches papers and extracts key findings to help scope a problem and find gaps.

problem.name: Consensus
problem.description: AI search engine over academic papers, useful for quickly checking what's already established about a topic.

problem.name: Perplexity
problem.description: AI answer engine with citations, good for fast background scoping before committing to a problem statement.

problem.name: Claude
problem.description: Conversational AI useful for iterating on problem statements, aims, objectives and research questions.

literature.name: Elicit
literature.description: Extracts and tabulates findings across many papers, speeding up systematic-style literature scans.

literature.name: Litmaps
literature.description: Citation-mapping tool that visually tracks how a literature area develops over time.

literature.name: Connected Papers
literature.description: Builds a visual graph of related papers from a single seed paper to reveal clusters and gaps.

literature.name: Scite
literature.description: Shows how a paper has been cited (supporting/contrasting/mentioning) to help judge evidence strength.

literature.name: ResearchRabbit
literature.description: Free citation-based discovery tool ('Spotify for papers') for building a reading list from seed papers.

literature.name: Semantic Scholar
literature.description: AI-powered academic search with TLDR summaries and influential-citation signals.

framework.name: Claude
framework.description: Good for talking through candidate theories, mapping variables, and drafting a conceptual model narrative.

framework.name: NotebookLM
framework.description: Grounds an AI assistant in your own uploaded sources (papers, notes) to help build a framework from your literature only.

framework.name: Miro AI
framework.description: AI-assisted mind-mapping/whiteboard for laying out constructs and their relationships visually.

methodology.name: Claude
methodology.description: Useful for reasoning through design choices (qual/quant/mixed), sampling logic, and instrument wording.

methodology.name: Julius AI
methodology.description: AI data analyst that can help plan analysis approaches and simulate what an analysis plan will produce.

methodology.name: jamovi
methodology.description: Free statistics package with a guided interface, helpful for planning quantitative analysis power/design.

ethics.name: Claude
ethics.description: Helps draft ethics application narratives, consent forms, and risk/benefit sections from your protocol notes.

ethics.name: Grammarly
ethics.description: Tightens the language of ethics submissions and participant-facing documents for clarity and tone.

datacollection.name: Otter.ai
datacollection.description: AI transcription for interviews and focus groups with speaker labels, exportable to coding software.

datacollection.name: Qualtrics XM
datacollection.description: Survey platform with AI-assisted question design and response-quality checks.

datacollection.name: Google Forms
datacollection.description: Simple, free survey collection; pairs well with AI tools downstream for analysis.

datacleaning.name: OpenRefine
datacleaning.description: Free tool for cleaning and transforming messy tabular data, with clustering to catch inconsistent entries.

datacleaning.name: Julius AI
datacleaning.description: Describe cleaning steps in plain English (missing values, coding, recoding) and get runnable output.

dataanalysis.name: Julius AI
dataanalysis.description: Conversational data analyst: upload a dataset, ask for statistics, models, or charts in plain English.

dataanalysis.name: ATLAS.ti AI
dataanalysis.description: AI-assisted coding suggestions for qualitative data (interviews, open-ended text).

dataanalysis.name: MAXQDA AI Assist
dataanalysis.description: AI features for summarizing and coding qualitative material inside MAXQDA.

dataanalysis.name: jamovi
dataanalysis.description: Free, open statistics software (regression, ANOVA, factor analysis) with an accessible interface.

results.name: Julius AI
results.description: Turns analysis output into publication-style charts and a plain-language explanation of results.

results.name: BioRender
results.description: AI-assisted scientific figure and diagram creation for presenting results and models.

results.name: Claude
results.description: Helps draft the discussion section: comparing findings to literature and flagging over-claims.

conclusion.name: Claude
conclusion.description: Helps synthesize findings into a tight conclusion and turn limitations into concrete future-research directions.

conclusion.name: Grammarly
conclusion.description: Final clarity, tone and grammar pass on the conclusion and recommendations.

publication.name: Paperpal
publication.description: Academic-writing checker built for manuscripts: language, structure, and journal-submission readiness.

publication.name: Trinka
publication.description: Grammar and academic style checker tuned for technical/scientific writing and journal conventions.

publication.name: Writefull
publication.description: AI writing feedback trained on published academic text; integrates with Overleaf and Word.

publication.name: Scholarcy
publication.description: Summarizes papers into structured flashcards and can generate reference summaries for a manuscript.

publication.name: DeepL Write
publication.description: AI editor for clarity and tone, useful for non-native-English authors polishing a submission.
